profile.summary: sheplu is a mid-level JavaScript reviewer with strong expertise in Node.js backend ecosystems, particularly Express.js, testing frameworks (Mocha/Supertest), and dependency management. Their reviews demonstrate deep knowledge of backend development practices, including semantic versioning, async testing patterns, and project organization. While their focus is entirely on backend systems, they show proficiency in modern JavaScript ES6+ features and asynchronous programming. There is no evidence of frontend JavaScript or TypeScript experience in their reviewed contributions. Their review patterns indicate a testing-first mentality and attention to code quality through dependency upgrades and documentation organization.
